name: thinking-skills
description: Thinking skills for agents: creative (past the typical answer), heavy-think (parallel perspectives), council (ideas that build on each other), debate (live pressure-testing), ambition (aim higher, with an outside judge), and the idea skills (idea-bank, idea-mine, idea-forge, idea-scout, co-read, idea-present: break sources into building blocks, recombine them into new ideas and kill-test them).
